Name: Pigeons Plus
Author: Alleyballey28
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43365][size=5][center]Check out the 1.6 Version![/center][/size][/url]

This mod is inspired by Rangerkatt's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2513]Pigeons and Doves Mod[/url]!
This mod REQUIRES omena007's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8540]Pigeons and Doves mod.[/url]
This mod offers reskins of the original 6 pigeons and doves with the addition of 4 more variants.

[b]*Now with Easier installation![/b]

Each will drop 1 pigeon egg when they are satisfied. Pigeon mayo takes 2 pigeon eggs (because the eggs are so small)
Pigeons themselves are 300 gold
Pigeon eggs sell for 20 gold
Pigeon mayo sells for 100 gold

Pigeons have a chance to drop Downy feathers!

These sell for 150 gold, however if 3 are combined with fabric you can create a Feather pillow! These sell for 2000 gold and Every villager (except Sebastian) love them!

[b]How to add Pigeons Plus content to your game[/b]
REQUIREMENTS:
>SMAPI
> BFAV
>Json Assets
> Pigeons and Doves BFAV, by Omena007
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Install the Pigeons and Doves BFAV mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8540)
2. Unzip it and move it to your Stardew Valley Mods folder
    The mod folder it will produce is "Pigeons". Inside are 2 folders. [BFAV] Pigeons and [JA] Pigeon Surprise.
3. Download Pigeons Plus and unzip it.
4. Drag all folders from Pigeons Plus into "Pigeons"
5. Allow it to replace files from the BFAV pigeons folder.
